verses.text: Lord , I have many enemies! Many people have turned against me.
Many are saying about me, “God won’t rescue him.” Selah
But, Lord , you are my shield, my wonderful God who gives me courage.
I will pray to the Lord , and he will answer me from his holy mountain. Selah
I can lie down and go to sleep, and I will wake up again, because the Lord gives me strength.
Thousands of troops may surround me, but I am not afraid.
Lord , rise up! My God, come save me! You have struck my enemies on the cheek; you have broken the teeth of the wicked.
The Lord can save his people. Lord , bless your people. Selah
